{{Quote|The only limit a Hutt perceives is its own absence of one.|Bokran Rix|<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />}}
'''Bokran Rix''' was a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Poet/Legends|poet]]. Rix observed that the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who had subjugated the Niktos of [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]], only perceived the absence of a limit as being a limitation.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
